cards.hint: Focus on the presidents power over new laws
cards.quote: The president can veto legislation created by Congress. He or she also nominates heads of federal agencies and high court appointees.
cards.stem: What can the president do to a bill passed by Congress

cards.hint: Think about approval of agency heads and judges
options: confirms or rejects the president's nominees
cards.quote: Congress confirms or rejects the president's nominees. It can also remove the president from office in exceptional circumstances.
cards.stem: How can Congress act on nominees for agencies and high courts

cards.hint: Think about what happens to laws that violate the Constitution
cards.quote: The Justices of the Supreme Court can overturn unconstitutional laws. These justices are nominated by the president and confirmed by the Senate.
cards.stem: What can Supreme Court Justices do to a law that violates the Constitution

cards.hint: Think about how branches limit each other
options: commander in chief of the armed forces
cards.quote: The ability of each branch to respond to the actions of the other branches is the system of checks and balances.
cards.stem: What is the name for the ability of branches to respond to each other

checks.message: every quiz text length, id pattern and id uniqueness is within the frozen limits
all 4 card quote(s) appear verbatim in their cited source after whitespace normalisation (quote-verbatim)
every card's correct answer options[0] occurs in its quote after normalisation, with any numbers matching as whole signed numbers (answer-in-quote)
every card has distinct options after normalisation, with no two options spelling the same number (options-distinct)
no stem contains its own correct answer (stem-no-answer-leak)
exactly one option per card matches the quote (one-correct)
every number in stems, options and hints appears on the cited page or in the same quote as that whole signed number (N-01) (numbers-checkable)
no distractor occurs in its card quote (distractors-not-in-quote)
